precision_analysis.precision_explanation: In a multi-document corpus where target documents have ~2 chunks, retrieving top_k=5 results in ~1.61 target chunks and ~2.81 near-neighbor chunks above threshold 0.65. When a document only possesses 2 chunks, the maximum possible chunk-level precision for top_k=5 is 2/5 = 0.40. Observed precision 0.3211 confirms the retriever is fetching the complete target document chunks plus valid competing context.
